root: ^Nell dusts flour from her apron. "A warm loaf travels better than an empty stomach."

c-0: ^"A loaf restores 20 Stamina. It costs five gold, and you can keep up to 99 in one stack. Eating it is your choice; buying it won't fill you up."
c-1: ^"Fresh from the oven. I've wrapped it for the road."
c-2: ^"Odd sells potions south of the square. Bram can mend a worn weapon. Then follow the northern road to Aren."
